about:
Welcome to GG-O, an online magazine and community platform for young Vietnamese people who love Korean culture (K-Culture).

At GG-O, we share timely, accurate and practical updates on trends in Korea: independent travel, local food, K-Beauty, fashion, shopping tips and useful hot deals. We also build a respectful, open community where young people can share experiences, discuss ideas and connect through their interests.

Our goal is to become a trusted cultural bridge between Korea and Vietnam, offering informative, high-quality content completely free of charge.

- Official website: https://gg-o.com
- Contact email: contact.us.ggo@gmail.com
terms:
1. Acceptance of terms

By accessing and using the GG-O website (https://gg-o.com), you agree to comply with the following terms and conditions. If you do not agree, please stop using the service.

2. Community content rules

Members are fully responsible for the content they publish, including posts, comments and images. The following are strictly prohibited:

- Posting unlawful content or promoting hatred, discrimination or obscenity.
- Spam, unauthorized advertising, malware and phishing links.
- Infringing another person or organization’s copyright, privacy or reputation.

GG-O administrators may remove content or restrict accounts that violate these terms without prior notice.

3. Intellectual property

All magazine articles, designs, logos and source code belong to GG-O, except content posted by users. Commercial copying without prior written permission is prohibited.

4. Disclaimer

Information on GG-O is provided for reference only. We are not responsible for losses arising from personal transactions between members or information on third-party websites.
privacy:
At GG-O (https://gg-o.com), protecting visitors’ privacy is a priority. This policy explains the types of information we collect and how we use them.

1. Information we collect

- Account information: When you register or sign in through a third-party provider such as Google OAuth, we collect only the email address, display name and basic profile image needed to maintain your account.
- Log files: IP addresses, browser types, Internet service providers (ISPs), timestamps and pages viewed may be collected to analyze trends and administer the website.

2. Cookies and Google AdSense (third-party advertising)

- We use cookies to save visitors’ preferences and improve their experience.
- Google AdSense: Google, a third-party advertising provider, uses cookies, including DART cookies, to show advertisements based on visits to GG-O and other websites.
- You may opt out of DART cookies by visiting Google’s advertising and content network privacy policy: https://policies.google.com/technologies/ads

3. Data protection and third-party disclosure

We do not sell, exchange or transfer personal information to third parties, except when required by law.

4. Contact

For questions about this privacy policy, please contact: contact.us.ggo@gmail.com
